title: Ahom-Mughal Relations: A Study in Diplomatic History (1600-1663)
title_english: Ahom-Mughal Relations: A Study in Diplomatic History (1600-1663)
title_as: আহোম-মোগল সম্পৰ্ক: কূটনৈতিক ইতিহাসৰ এক অধ্যয়ন (১৬০০-১৬৬৩)
author: Dr. Govinda Ballav Goswami, Ph.D.
category: Gauhati University Doctoral Theses & Frontier Studies
provenance: Gauhati University / Shillong: Sankardev College / Internet Archive (ahom-mughal-relations-study-in-diplomatic-history-1600-1663)
license: Open Access / Academic Research (Fair Use / Mark 1.0)
description: Definitive diplomatic history of the military encounters and treaty negotiations between the Tai-Ahom kingdom of Assam and the Mughal Empire between 1600 and 1663 A.D. Analyzes the diplomatic letters (kataki-patras) exchanged between the royal court at Garhgaon and Mughal subahdars (Mir Jumla, Nawab Allah Yar Khan), detailing border demarcations at the Asurar Ali (1639), tribute negotiations, envoy immunities, and trans-Patkai frontier alliances.
